description: Polls an order placed by this agent. Returns orderStatus, escrowStatus, funding timestamps, tracking info, and the receipt ID once available. Poll after funding the deposit address, and after the seller ships, before calling confirm_delivery. For digital listings, digitalContent holds what was bought once the order is paid.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

name: get_order
